# Project instructions

This repository is the Brew & Bean PHP/MySQL coffee shop application. Follow `rules.md` for implementation and validation conventions.

## Keep project documentation current

Whenever you make an AI-assisted code, configuration, database, or design change:

1. Review `prd.md`, `architecture.md`, `rules.md`, `design.md`, `task.md`, and `README.md`.
2. Update the documents affected by the change in the same work. Keep product behavior, architecture, design, setup, and task status consistent with the implementation.
3. Update `task.md` with verified completion and remaining checks. Update `README.md` when setup, runtime, or user-visible behavior changes.
4. Do this proactively without asking the user for a separate documentation prompt. Do not claim docs are regenerated by a watcher or guarantee updates for edits made outside an AI coding assistant.

Do not invent product requirements or mark unrun validation as passed. If a code change conflicts with existing documentation, make the implementation and documentation consistent before finishing.
